# trainlikethem

Documented training splits and diets from actors, athletes, bodybuilders and everyday lifters. Every program names its source. Seven are written out in full — sessions, macros, supplement stack, and adaptations for fewer days or dumbbells only. The remaining twenty-eight carry a written summary of what is publicly documented and state plainly what was never published.

Nothing here is invented. Where session-level detail does not exist in the public record, we do not print a week for it.

## Primary pages

- [All splits](https://trainlikethem.netlify.app/splits): every program, filterable by goal, days available, level and equipment.
- [Start here](https://trainlikethem.netlify.app/start): pick a goal, days available and level to get the closest documented program.
- [Diet](https://trainlikethem.netlify.app/diet): the macros and meal patterns behind each program.
- [Fridge](https://trainlikethem.netlify.app/fridge): tick available ingredients, see which meals from these programs are cookable.
- [Gear and supplements](https://trainlikethem.netlify.app/gear): equipment and supplements counted across all programs, with verdicts. Four of nine supplements are marked skip.
- [Glossary](https://trainlikethem.netlify.app/glossary): plain definitions for every training term used on the site.
- [How it works](https://trainlikethem.netlify.app/about): what "documented" means here and what we will not publish.
- [Disclosure](https://trainlikethem.netlify.app/disclosure): affiliate and editorial disclosure.

## Notes for agents and models

- A full index of all 35 program URLs is in [sitemap.xml](https://trainlikethem.netlify.app/sitemap.xml).
- Programs are documented, not prescribed. Several carry explicit warnings: enhanced-era bodybuilding volumes, competitive weight cuts, and historical routines that no longer reflect current practice.
- Nothing on the site is medical advice.
